scope.selection_rule: A direct link is eligible for runtime display only when the video visibly demonstrates the chunk's physical or UI procedure. Supporting links remain in this audit only; remove links are excluded from both runtime and evaluation media expectations.
scope.review_method: Official YouTube player visual review. Captions were unavailable for Imager and M.2 HAT+; the High Quality Camera video's available transcript was used only to confirm the observed physical sequence.
